name: Hanabusa Saki
source:
Koharu's older sister. She claims to be a wandering artist and has been drifting all around the world, but recently returned to her hometown and took up a position as a temporary instructor at Seirei Academy, which Souta and the others attend.

In the art world she is actually quite well-known, and if she put her mind to it, she supposedly has the talent to hold her own solo exhibitions. Her personality is fickle, and her enthusiasm never lasts long. She is a genius and a natural disaster. Because her words and actions are entirely without context and completely reckless, those who are close to her (those who know her well) tend to avoid getting involved with her.

She always keeps her pet turtle inside her lab coat.

Favorite things: Sake, art in general (especially paintings), traveling
Disliked things: Things that not tasty, troublesome things

[Translated from the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/sprinkle/character/chara7.php#chara-main]official site[/url]]
